comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: An island where humans are not the "rulers"! Can you believe that the 1,700 residents here willingly close roads, step aside, and even build special bridges and tunnels just to let... 100 million red crabs cross to the sea to spawn! On Christmas Island, humans have learned to adapt and yield to nature instead of forcing nature to submit. Who else wants to witness this surreal phenomenon at least once in their life? 🦀🌉
